task_summary: This image is a close crop around one hand, cut from a video of a person playing rock-paper-scissors. Classify which sign the hand is clearly showing.
visual_cues: rock: closed fist, all four fingers curled into the palm (thumb may wrap across or rest alongside)
paper: open flat hand, all four fingers extended and visible (spread or together), any orientation
scissors: exactly two fingers (index + middle) extended, in a V or side by side, upright, sideways or pointing at the camera; the other fingers curled
none: anything that is not clearly one of the three: motion-blurred hand, half-formed shape, single pointing finger, relaxed hanging hand, hand mostly out of frame, or no hand (e.g. a face or shirt)

question.name: sign
question.instructions: The image is a crop around a hand. Which rock-paper-scissors sign is the hand CLEARLY showing right now? rock = closed fist with all fingers curled in. paper = open hand with all four fingers extended. scissors = only the index and middle fingers extended (V shape, side by side, or pointing toward the camera like a finger-gun with two fingers), other fingers curled. Answer none if the hand is motion-blurred so the fingers can't be counted, the shape is still forming, only ONE finger is extended, the hand is relaxed/hanging or pointing, most of the hand is cut off, or there is no hand. Count only the index, middle, ring and little fingers; the THUMB never matters (a thumb sticking up next to two extended fingers, like a two-finger 'finger gun', is still scissors). Judge only by which fingers are extended; ignore hand orientation, which hand (left/right), the person, and the background.

choices.description: Closed fist; no fingers extended (thumb position doesn't matter)
Open hand; all four fingers extended, spread or together, any orientation
Index and middle fingers extended (V, side by side, or a two-finger 'finger gun'; any orientation; thumb ignored), ring and little fingers curled
Not clearly a sign: blur, mid-transition, one finger, relaxed/pointing hand, mostly out of frame, or no hand

edge_cases: Motion blur where the finger count can't be read: none
Hand in transition (fingers half-open or half-closed): none
Single index finger raised or pointing: none (not scissors)
Index + middle extended together with the thumb up (two-finger 'finger gun'): scissors
Two fingers extended but blurred or partly cut off at the crop edge: scissors only if both fingers are clearly separate from the fist
Thumb sticking out of a fist (thumbs-up-like): rock
Crop shows a face, shirt or arm with no readable hand: none
